title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
About Upstart

At Upstart , we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:
Upstart 's Product & Growth Analytics team drives strategic insights and evidence-based decision-making across our expanding portfolio of credit products. Our team works at the intersection of product strategy, data science, and business impact, partnering with product leaders, the ML organization, and finance to shape how Upstart evolves its offerings and delivers value to borrowers and banking partners.
We're entering a new chapter. As Upstart expands into subscription-based products, we need to rethink how we approach data science and analytics from the ground up. This requires people who don't just answer questions, but ask the right ones first. People who dive into ambiguity, surface what matters, and guide the business toward smarter decisions.
As a Principal Data Scientist, you'll be a strategic thought partner to product, marketing, finance, and ML leaders, helping them optimize the decisions in their domains. You'll combine deep technical expertise with the judgment to know which problems merit rigorous experimentation, which require causal inference, and which first demand foundational business understanding. You will additionally build out technical tools to improve our understanding of the business, with examples including forecasting models, spend allocation optimization, marketing incrementality, and attribution models.
How you’ll make an impact

• Shape strategic direction by identifying the gaps and questions others miss. You're not waiting for orders; you're setting the agenda.

• Be a thought partner to leaders across product, finance, and ML. You help them understand complex problems from first principles and define what actually matters.

• Design, build, and own tools that are leveraged across the team, such as models for forecasting change, optimizing spend allocation, marketing incrementality, and attribution.

• Design and execute experiments, from classic A/B tests to complex causal inference analyses, with full ownership of hypothesis development, experiment design, and results interpretation.

• Build metrics frameworks and measurement strategies, helping stakeholders understand what to optimize for and why.

• Collaborate with our ML organization on high-complexity technical challenges, bringing statistical rigor and causal reasoning to our work.

• Translate ambiguous, multifaceted business problems into clear frameworks that guide decision-making.

title: Staff Controls Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Motor Control Algorithm Development
•       Design and implement field-oriented control (FOC), six-step commutation, and direct torque control algorithms for BLDC and PMSM motors
•       Develop sensorless rotor position estimation techniques (back-EMF observer, sliding-mode observer, high-frequency injection) for applications where Hall sensors or encoders are not viable
•       Design current, speed, and position control loops with rigorous bandwidth, stability margins, and disturbance rejection specifications
Modelling & Simulation (MIL / SIL / HIL)
•       Build high-fidelity motor and inverter plant models in MATLAB / Simulink, including magnetic saturation, iron losses, and thermal coupling
•       Develop controller models and validate performance through Model-in-the-Loop (MIL) simulation against requirements
•       Execute Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing using Embedded Coder auto-generated C code to verify fixed-point scaling, quantisation effects, and code-generation fidelity
•       Support Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) integration with real-time simulators (dSPACE, Typhoon HIL, or equivalent) for full controller board validation
•       Integrate Simulink auto-coded algorithm modules with the microcontroller RTOS, peripheral drivers, and application framework
Firmware & Embedded Systems
•       Implement motor control firmware in C on microcontrollers (e.g., STM32, TI C2000, NXP S32K) with hard real-time constraints
•       Configure and optimise motor control peripherals: PWM timers, ADC synchronisation, encoder/Hall interfaces, comparator-based overcurrent protection
•       Architect firmware for deterministic control loop execution - interrupt prioritisation, DMA pipelines, and minimal-jitter scheduling
•       Implement fault detection, diagnosis, and safe-state management in firmware (overcurrent, overvoltage, overtemperature, sensor loss, stall, phase loss)
•       Develop communication interfaces (CAN, SPI, UART, RS-485) for command, telemetry, and diagnostics

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

•       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience
•       10+ years of professional experience designing and implementing motor control algorithms (FOC, Trapezoidal, or equivalent) for BLDC or PMSM motors
•       Strong foundation in classical and modern control theory - PID tuning, frequency-domain analysis, state estimation, observer design
•       Proficiency in MATLAB / Simulink, PLEC

title: [MSO] Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer (Ansible)
description:
Project - the aim you’ll have
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineer to help build an automation practice for a leading IT infrastructure provider in the Netherlands.

Automation is already being done, but it has grown in several directions at once - different approaches, different standards and different repository layouts running in parallel. A large part of this role is bringing that together into one practice the whole team works with.

You will join a 12+ person Polish engineering team responsible for maintaining the client's Linux and Windows estate and for delivering transformation projects on it. The environment carries a significant legacy footprint, built up over years of operations. At the same time we are building a completely new platform based on OpenStack, so the automation you create will cover both: keeping the existing estate running, and making sure the new platform is automated from day one rather than years later.

You will also have a software development team as a help, so when something needs to be properly engineered rather than scripted around, you will not be solving it alone.

Your first deliverable is continuous patching across Linux and Windows - moving the client from scheduled manual patching cycles to an automated, continuously running process. From there the practice expands into deployment automation, configuration management and process automation across the estate.
Role - how you’ll contribute

• Writing Ansible automation - playbooks, roles, modules and collections - this is the core, day-to-day work of the role

• Help shape the automation practice: standards, repository structure and code review process, worked out together with the team

• Patch management automation

• Deployment automation

• Configuration management

• Systems and process automation

• Project-driven infrastructure transformations - bring automation into the transformation projects the team delivers, so that what is built new is automated from the start

• Support, configure and manage the automation platform

• Automation-related code review and maintenance across the team

• CI/CD configuration and management for automation code

• Define and maintain the inventory and source of truth the automation runs against

• Introduce testing for automation code, so changes can be released to a production estate with confidence

• Work with engineers maintaining the estate to identify what should be automated next, and in what order

• Share knowledge with the team so the practice is something everyone can work with

• Produce and maintain the technical documentation that makes the practice usable by others

Expectations - the experience you need

• Advanced knowledge and experience in using, configuring and maintaining automation platforms, preferably AAP/AWX

Hi, we are AMBOSS, and we are looking for an experienced marketer to drive our growth globally.

ABOUT AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video https://www.youtube.com/@ambosscareers to explore what makes us unique.

WHY CAN THIS POSITION BE EXCITING FOR YOU?

Many of our students and clinicians access AMBOSS through an institutional license from their medical school or hospital. In this role, you’ll own the marketing that turns those license holders into active, engaged AMBOSS users and, ultimately, advocates. You’ll sit between our B2B Sales/Regional teams and our consumer marketing teams, with a clear focus on adoption and engagement of institutional customers.

A license only creates value once someone opens AMBOSS, finds the answer they need before an exam or at the bedside, and comes back the next day. You’ll make that first step easy and help it become a habit. Your work shows up in how many students and physicians actually use AMBOSS, in how confident our Sales and Regional teams feel going into renewals, and in how many future doctors make better decisions for their patients. You’ll build initiatives that work globally and still feel local to each campus and hospital. If you enjoy seeing a direct line from a campaign to real usage, this role gives you plenty of room to build.

YOU WILL:

- Own the end-user journey from “license granted” to “actively using AMBOSS,” including onboarding, activation, and ongoing engagement for students and physicians on institutional licenses.

- Build and maintain automated CRM flows for onboarding, feature announcements, and re-engagement, tailored by audience (students vs. physicians) and institution type.

- Support institutional renewals by identifying low-usage accounts and running targeted engagement campaigns, in close coordination with Sales and Account/Regional Managers.

- Create and maintain institution-facing collateral (onboarding kits, flyers, one-pagers, usage summaries) that Sales and Regional teams use to support rollouts and renewals.

- Own and optimize CMS content and landing pages for institutional end users, including license activation and sign-up flows.

- Partner with institutions on local activation, such as campus ambassador programs, webinars, and events.

YOU BRING:

- 3-4+ years of experience in B2B, B2B2C, SAAS, or edtech marketing,

- Hands-on experience with CRM/marketing automation tools.

- Strong ownership and accountability in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

- Detail-oriented ownership of content quality across CMS, CRM, and collateral.

- Data-driven decision-making, even with imperfect or limited data sets.

- Proactive in spotting activation/usage gaps and proposing fixes, not just reporting metrics.

- Excellent stakeholder management across global/local and marketing/sales teams.

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

At Vanta, being an Enterprise SDR is first about hitting targets and driving revenue. It also means joining a community that’s committed to your success and career growth. We believe the future of our sales organization lies with our SDRs, so we invest heavily in enablement and career advancement. You’ll get the training, support and mentorship you need to excel, with a clear path to an Account Executive role.

 

As an Enterprise SDR, you’ll partner with Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, Marketing and channel partners to create pipeline at large organizations (2,000+ employees). You’ll engage senior security, risk and compliance leaders who are under growing pressure from audits, security reviews, third-party risk and AI governance.

 

You don’t need SaaS or cybersecurity experience to be great at this job. We’ll teach you the product, the tools and the process. What we can’t teach is drive, curiosity and coachability, and that’s what we’re hiring for. Great SDRs come from everywhere: commission- or tip-based roles, hospitality, retail, call centers, fundraising, recruiting, real estate, political campaigns, competitive athletics, or something they started on their own.

 

Vanta is growing quickly and is profitable. We keep beating our growth targets while maintaining very strong NPS scores, so it’s an exciting time to join. If you’re hungry to learn and ready to work hard, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do as a Sales Development Representative at Vanta:

- Learn Vanta’s value proposition and Trust Management Platform, including compliance automation, continuous monitoring, Trust Center, questionnaire automation, vendor risk management and AI governance. Explain them clearly and confidently to enterprise buyers.

- Own a named book of enterprise accounts. Build account plans and run multi-threaded outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn, using tools you’ll be trained on: Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Nooks, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Nav, 6Sense and Gong.

- Prospect into senior leaders such as CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, VPs and Directors of Security, Heads of GRC, Compliance Managers, and IT Risk and Internal Audit leaders.

- Research accounts to find why-now triggers, such as new frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO 42001), new security leadership, M&A, funding, audit findings or vendor risk initiatives.

DMI , LLC is seeking a Scrum Master to run the delivery cadence on a ServiceNow service management program for a customer on Capitol Hill. The Scrum Master owns the sprint rhythm: facilitation of every ceremony, removal of impediments, coaching of the team and the customer Product Owner, and coordination of Agile delivery with release management, testing, deployment, and organizational change management. title: Supply and Demand Planner

Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility in getting the right products to our members at the right time. You’ll own our robust short and long-range forecasts and demand plans, bringing together seasonal patterns, customer trends and upcoming marketing activity to determine optimal purchasing volumes across all of our product types.

You’ll build the long-term view of our monthly themes, finding smart ways to put excess legacy kits and theme stock to good use where appropriate. From there, you’ll break that plan down into full theme forecasts and fortnightly production plans, agreed with our 3PL partner.

You’ll also be the go-to person for stock reporting, reconciling our internal view of stock against supplier stock levels, taking into account both regular reporting and every stock movement, so the business always has an accurate picture.

Great communication is key to success in this role. You’ll work closely with your own team and the wider business, bringing data to life through clear, visual reporting that gives everyone complete transparency.

Working alongside our Supply Chain Director and Operations Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we plan, driving improvements in forecasting accuracy and building processes that reduce excess stock and risk. Contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

• Collaborate with the marketing team to understand their plans and objectives and reflect these in forecasting.

• Partner with the Head Buyers to drive commercial opportunities through the strategic timing of themes, and to ensure consistent stock availability for retail opportunities and permanent listings with key partners.

• Calculate and submit purchasing volumes for subscription and shop through a defined S&OP process, using available technology to improve accuracy, and work with the Supply Chain. Director to ensure a smooth sign-off.

• Report on overall stock levels, weekly progress on reducing excess and short-dated stock, and upcoming risks and priorities.

• Work with marketing, the Operations Manager and the Supply Chain Director to clear short-dated stock, including promotional packs and shop activity, so that every short-dated item has a plan and no expired product is used.

• Work with our 3PL to plan and direct production, minimizing delays to order dispatch. 

• Work with the wider team to plan brew and drawdown schedules for Welcome Box beer and wine, and to ensure consistent availability of non-core items such as packaging, magazines and snacks.

• Identify opportunities to sell surplus stock through other Beer52 channels.

• Work with the Supply Chain Director and Operations Manager to deliver peak forecasts and forward plans that manage volume increases.

• Develop robust processes and tools that promote good practice and continuous improvement.

3PL Supervision:

• Share forecasts as appropriate to allow for efficient production planning.

• Maintain an internal stock tracking system and carry out regular data quality checks to hold the 3PL to account and ensure FIFO/FEFO is followed.

title: Regional Sales Manager, North America
description:
Sell Sweetspot to golf venues across North America, then stay with them as their main contact for the long run. Full-cycle sales and account ownership in one role, as one of our first hires in North America.
About Sweetspot
We make golf more valuable - to the player who shows up, the operator who runs the venue, and the game itself. It's the test we hold everything we build to.
Sweetspot is the commercial platform for modern golf facilities: bookings, payments, memberships, dynamic pricing, POS, the player app, revenue management agents and the reporting that finally tells an operator what all of it earns. We build for the facility because that's where golf actually happens. When a venue knows its players, it can give every one of them a reason to come back, and that's how the game grows. Golf will never be worth enough, so we'll never be done.
500+ facilities in 20 countries, built in Sweden - and North America is where we're growing fastest. This is one of the first hires on the ground, so you won't inherit a playbook. You'll write it with us, and every venue you sign is one more place where golf is worth more than it was the year before.
The opportunity
Most range and simulator operators here can't answer the question their business rests on: what is an hour of bay time worth, and when? They price the same bucket at 7am Tuesday as at 6pm Friday. They don't know which bays sit cold or which members quietly stopped coming. The data exists - it's just scattered across a booking tool, a POS, a Toptracer bay and somebody's spreadsheet, none of which talk.
We put it in one place and then do something with it: pricing that fills the cold hours, memberships that make revenue forecastable, utilization and yield reported per bay and per hour. It isn't a software sale. You show an owner what their venue could earn, then stay and make it happen.
What we believe about the relationship
Golf is a small industry and it runs on people. An operator who bought from you does not want to be handed to a stranger the week after go-live - so we don't do that. You keep your customers. You sign them, you see them through the switch, and you're still the name in their phone two years later when they're opening a second site.
That's a deliberate choice. It costs more per rep and it means we hire people who can do both halves of the job. It's also why our customers stay, and why they take our call when we have something new to sell them.

title: Product Manager, Impact Platform & Experimentation
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Join the Experimentation & Impact Platform at Vinted. We are two closely linked teams in Data Infrastructure that build the internal products Vinted uses to ship features safely and make decisions based on evidence. Teams across Marketplace, Vinted Go and Vinted Pay use our tools. Product, Engineering, Data and Design people use them every day to roll out features, run experiments and understand impact.

• Impact Platform builds Impact, our self-service feature-flag and experimentation platform. That includes SDKs for Ruby, JavaScript, Go, iOS and Android, the backend services, and the Impact web UI. Impact handles about 20 million flag evaluations per second.

• Experimentation builds the standardised metrics framework and automated experiment analysis pipelines. It also owns cumulative impact reporting, which tracks the observed effect of shipped work across 17 key business metrics and feeds into Marketplace planning. The team also creates educational material and helps with complex analysis cases.

As the Product Manager for both teams, you'll own one shared product backlog. It covers feature flagging, experiment setup, metric standardisation, analysis automation and impact reporting. Your work won't affect just one product area. It shapes how the whole company learns and decides. Our vision: no decision at Vinted, large or small, is made without solid experimental evidence behind it. Join us in making sustainable consumption the first choice worldwide.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own the needs of our internal users: engineers, product managers, designers, decision scientists and analysts, and leadership. Talk to them regularly to understand their pain points with feature flags, experiment setup, metrics and results, so the right workflow is the easy one.

• Work with engineers (data, backend and web), data scientists and our Product Designer to shape and deliver a roadmap that makes experiments faster to set up, results more trustworthy and quicker to arrive, and learnings easier to find.

• Own and prioritise one backlog across two teams. Balance new capabilities with platform reliability, migration work and tech debt, and choose high-value, low-effort solutions where you can.

• Define and track product success with metrics such as experiment volume and validity, conclusive experiment rate, time to set up an experiment, experiment duration and platform adoption.

• Run our feedback loop, including the public roadmap, the request intake and support flow, survey

title: Sr. SDE (Email)
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team:

The Email team owns the Email platform behind HighLevel 's email experience, which powers 40M+ emails a day. We own the full path from compose to inbox, so the reliability, speed and quality of what we ship directly decide whether emails from over a million businesses land in the inbox.

We are responsible for:

• Email Platform: The Vue.js apps used to design, compose and send emails, plus the Node.js/NestJS services behind them.

• Sending Infrastructure & Deliverability: IP pools, dedicated IPs, dedicated domains and shared domain pools. These let new users send from day one, while we stay accountable for getting their email into the inbox.

• API-First Platform: Every capability is exposed through APIs, so email can be built into any product or workflow that needs it.

• Scale & Reliability: Keeping throughput high at peak load, with high uptime and send success rates.

• Email Statistics & Analytics: Integrating email stats with internal teams and making every release measurable on our dashboards.

• AI in Email: Bringing LLM-powered capabilities into email creation, while weighing token cost, latency and quality

Impact & Scale

Email is one of the most critical channels on HighLevel . When it works, businesses grow; when it breaks, their customers stop hearing from them. That's the weight this role carries.

• Businesses: Every one of the 1M+ businesses on HighLevel relies on email to reach their customers.

• Sub-accounts: Your work runs across 1.6M+ sub-accounts, from solo operators to agencies managing hundreds of clients.

• End users: What you ship reaches end users through 1.2B+ emails every month.

• Volume: 40M+ emails a day flow through the systems you'll own, so a 1% gain in reliability or deliverability affects hundreds of thousands of emails daily.

• Blast radius: One change can affect every business on the platform at once, which is why we care so much about reliability, data integrity and security.

How we work

• Iterate fast: Go from idea to prototype to production in days, not quarters. Ship small, measure, learn and improve.

• Use AI well: Use AI across the whole cycle (design, coding, testing, reviews and debugging) to move faster without lowering the quality bar, and pick the right model for each job based on quality, latency and cost.

title: AML Manager, Austria
description:
At bunq, we’re more than a bank. We’re on a mission to make banking work for people wherever they live in Europe. With local IBANs, our users can pay rent, sign up for the gym and get paid like a local from day one. Every successful transaction is a step toward making them feel at home and letting us truly “Make Life Easy.”
Austria is next, and we need someone on the ground to make it happen. As our AML Manager Austria, you’ll be bunq’s accountable local owner of compliance in Austria. You’ll help bring bunq into the market through the EU passporting process, then run AML operations, integrity risk and financial crime reporting for the country. You won’t have a local team. Instead, you’ll build and use AI tools that let one person cover what a traditional bank staffs with a full department.
Think you’re up for the challenge? Join us in making a real impact on users’ lives while scaling AML operations across Europe 🚀

What you’ll own

• Lead bunq’s entry into Austria by shaping the local content for the passporting notification to the FMA, including the business plan, organizational and operational setup, localization requirements and timelines, and set up your reporting line into HQ Compliance from day one

• Adapt bunq’s AML/CFT framework to Austrian law, own the integrity risk assessment (SIRA) and oversee FIU reporting, using AI-first processes that keep the branch compliant and every filing on time

• Be bunq’s trusted contact for the FMA, leading supervisory dialogues, audits and inspections

• You live in Austria and are fluent in German and English

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Austrian AML/CFT framework and FMA requirements, ideally from 7+ years in AML, fraud, KYC or CDD

• Experience contributing to a regulatory notification or licensing process, such as EU passporting or a banking/EMI license application

• A track record of owning a compliance program end to end and using AI tools to automate the work

• Sound regulatory judgment and a feel for balancing risk with the needs of a fast-growing tech company

• Nice to have: experience with AML inspections or regulatory audits, or with a role that owned several compliance areas at once.

Your space to perform
We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪🏼
🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset
🌟 Make lasting impact by working on complex & exciting challenges
👩‍💻 Remote setup: after 3 weeks onboarding in Amsterdam (“AMS”) office, work 2 weeks a quarter in AMS - the rest of time you can work in Austria.
💰 A competitive base annual salary range €108,000-€119,700, and final offer will be based on the candidate’s qualifications and competencies.
📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget
🚌 Travel expenses are covered for AMS visits
💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us
🧘 €60 monthly allowance that rolls over monthly and resets annually, replacing the phone/internet line above
🍹 Frequent epic events, including an annual bunq weekend away

title: People Integrations and AI Architect
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

This role will shape how our People technology ecosystem connects, automates and evolves as Legora scales. You'll own the integration architecture that connects our core HRIS to our wider technology stack, while building the AI-native capabilities that make it easier for employees, managers and the People team to get things done.

You'll join at a pivotal moment as we build the foundations of our global People technology ecosystem, helping us make the right architectural decisions from day one. You will build the hard pieces yourself, and make HRIS data and workflows usable by agents, automations, and MCP servers, creating new ways of interacting with People technology.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines deep integration engineering expertise with a passion for emerging technology. You'll work closely with People Technology, IT, Security and functional stakeholders who rely on People data, balancing speed and innovation with reliability, security and scalability.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- People Integration Architecture & Strategy. Define and own the integration architecture across our People technology ecosystem, with the HRIS at its core. Establish scalable design patterns, technical standards and governance for how systems exchange data and trigger workflows. Make decisions on when to use HRIS-native capabilities, middleware, APIs or custom solutions, balancing speed, maintainability and long-term scalability.

- AI & Intelligent Automation. Build the AI-native integration layer that enables employees, managers and the People team to interact with systems in new ways. Design and develop MCP servers, AI agents and intelligent workflows that securely access People data and execute actions across systems. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, enable self-service and bring People processes into the tools employees already use. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine when to leverage existing platforms versus building custom solutions.

- Security, Reliability & Governance. Establish the technical controls that make our integrations and AI capabilities secure, observable and dependable. Define standards for authentication, field-level permissions, monitoring, alerting, error handling, retries, testing and auditability. Own the ongoing integration lifecycle, including release testing, documentation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Partner with IT, Security and Legal to protect sensitive People data and ensure responsible AI use.

- Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence. Act as the technical authority for People

title: _ Expert General Ledger Accountant
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We are seeking a highly skilled, experienced, and proactive  Expert General Ledger Accountant to join our Central Accounting Team.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timely execution of General Ledger accounting activities, while contributing to risk management, process efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Beyond executing accounting activities, the successful candidate will be expected to work independently, anticipate challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and actively contribute to initiatives that strengthen financial operations.

The role requires close collaboration with regional and headquarters Finance teams, Tax, Legal, Systems, and other internal stakeholders.

About the Role

 

• Accounting, Budgeting & Tax Compliance: Lead best-in-class financial processes for the Hub entity, including budget/forecast monitoring, variance reporting, annual budgeting exercises, and coordination with external tax consultants for timely tax declarations, audits, and full regulatory compliance.

• General Ledger & Financial Control: Oversee GL accounting activities across all entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to corporate policies, accounting standards, and internal controls throughout monthly, quarterly, and annual closing cycles.

• Audit & Internal Controls Support: Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation, timely explanations, and ensuring compliance with established accounting procedures and control frameworks.

• Quality Service & Stakeholder Management: Deliver accurate, timely accounting services; proactively identify errors and process inefficiencies; implement corrective actions; maintain process documentation; and foster a service-oriented mindset with all internal stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Vision & Process Integration: Recognize and leverage the interconnection between GL and other functions (AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, FP&A) to drive process improvements and strengthen financial controls beyond transactional scope.

• Communication, Escalation & Collaboration: Communicate proactively and professionally with management and cross-functional stakeholders; provide timely updates on progress, risks, and issues; escalate concerns with context and proposed solutions; and apply active listening and collaborative problem-solving.

• Ownership, Continuous Improvement & Results Delivery: Demonstrate full accountability for deliverables, work independently under tight deadlines, anticipate operational challenges, and actively contribute to accounting transformation projects, system implementations, and process improvement initiatives in a fast-paced international environment.

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification preferred.

• Minimum of 8 years of relevant accounting or finance experience, with strong expertise in General Ledger accounting.

• Solid knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting requirements.

• Proven experience in financial closing, account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and accounting analysis.

• Knowledge in Mexican local tax compliance.

• Experience working with ERP systems, preferably Oracle Fusion.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.

• Experience in shared services environment.

• Experience participating in finance transformation, automation, or ERP implementation projects.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

title: Senior Implementation Consultant (French)
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Our Implementations and Onboarding team is responsible for understanding the relationships and desired outcomes established during the sales process, building a launch plan for success, and helping customers get the most out of 1Password's suite of products.

We are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and committed to building deep, trusted partnerships that help organizations succeed securely with 1Password.

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will lead the technical deployment and customer enablement of 1Password's product suite for our largest and most strategically important enterprise customers. Spacelift is an infrastructure orchestration platform that manages your entire infrastructure lifecycle - provisioning, configuration and governance. Spacelift integrates with all your infrastructure tooling (e.g. Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible) to provide a single integrated workflow so you can deliver secure, cost-effective, and resilient infrastructure, fast.
By automating deployment and configuration, providing developer self-service, golden paths with guardrails, and an OPA policy engine, Spacelift empowers businesses to accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control and governance over their infrastructure. Spacelift offers unrivalled support, no-nonsense pricing, and a range of deployment models to fit your specific needs.
Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms, including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.
Spacelift is building the infrastructure platform that engineering teams actually want to use. We're growing fast, and the partner channel is a core part of how we scale. We're looking for someone to own it.
Reporting to our RVP of Sales, we are looking for a tenacious and ambitious Enterprise Account Executive with experience selling developer tools to support the fast-growing demand for our product in the US market. We expect you to use your prospecting, sales, negotiation, and leadership skills to effectively sell Spacelift ’s offerings to enterprises of various sizes.
You will have a proven track record of success in a product-led growth model and experience building and closing a pipeline. You will partner with Sales Development Representatives in your region to identify prospects and build customer relationships.
What will you do

• Exceeding your number. Winning new logos.

• Developing and executing a comprehensive regional plan.

• Connecting with prospective customer contacts to achieve maximum sales growth and account penetration in the US market.

• Identifying prospects and driving momentum across multiple opportunities, delivering an unparalleled level of service to potential partners.

• Working with partners to extend reach & drive adoption.

• Managing the entire sales process from prospect to close.

• Understanding the product offering and competitive issues to develop proposals.

• Travelling to customer sites to identify/develop sales opportunities when required.

• Experience in working with Salesforce and other sales-oriented tracking tools.

About you

• Minimum of 5 years' experience selling developer tools to large enterprise customers

• Someone with experience in a start-up environment

• A consistent track record of over-achievement of quotas and revenue goals

• Experience practising and implementing a sales methodology, such as MEDDPICC

• Ability to effectively identify and sell to C-Level & technical leaders across both IT and business units

• A talent for relationship-building

• Comfortable negotiating SaaS/cloud/software contracts

• Outstanding communication skills - written and oral

• Ability to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, collaborative, and team-oriented environment

• Be based in the US in the Texas Area

Recruitment Process

• 30 minutes with Nuria Requena, Talent Acquisition Manager

• 45 minutes introductory video call with RVP Sales

• Final Interview with John Henry, SVP Sales

Why Spacelift ?

• Innovative Culture : Join a team shaping cloud infrastructure management’s future.

• Growth Opportunities : Be a key player in driving Spacelift ’s business and AWS partnership to new heights.

title: Senior Metallurgist - Remote
description:
Role Title: Senior Metallurgist / Welding Inspector
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (US-based preferred)
Job Summary
We are looking for experienced Senior Metallurgists and Welding Inspectors to support a project in advanced manufacturing and materials engineering. You’ll apply your expertise to evaluate materials, welds, coatings, and additive manufacturing components for AI training. AI experience is not required.
Scope of Work

• Evaluate metallographic microstructures for material acceptance and compliance.

• Review heat treatment processes according to AMS 2750, ASTM E112, and related standards.

• Assess weld quality through macro etch evaluation and CWI acceptance criteria.

• Conduct coating inspections based on NACE/AMPP and SSPC standards.

• Review and disposition LPBF additive manufacturing defects.

• Provide clear documentation and technical reasoning for accept/reject decisions.

• Apply relevant ASTM, AMS, AWS, NADCAP, NACE/AMPP, and SSPC standards.

Preferred Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience evaluating micrographs, welds, coatings, or additive manufacturing components.

• Strong knowledge of ASTM, AMS, AWS, NADCAP, NACE/AMPP, and SSPC standards.

• Current or previous AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification or equivalent.

• Experience in metallography, heat treatment, welding inspection, and coating assessment.

• Knowledge of additive manufacturing, particularly laser powder bed fusion (LPBF).

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and technical decision-making abilities.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Required Skills

• Metallographic Microstructure Evaluation

• Heat Treatment Acceptance (AMS 2750, ASTM E112)

• Weld Macro Etch & CWI Acceptance

• Coating Inspection (NACE/AMPP, SSPC)

• Additive Manufacturing (LPBF) Defect Disposition

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves-one that behaves like a doctor in the family.
About the role:
The Senior Specialist, Risk Adjustment for Medicare Advantage (MA) and Affordable Care Act (ACA) lines of business will work closely with management to meet communicated individual and departmental goals, deadlines set forth by Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and Health and Human Services (HHS) , and be active and engaged in establishing effective Risk Adjustment processes.
You will report into the Manager, Risk Adjustment.
Work Location: This position is fully remote and open to candidates residing in the U.S., excluding Alaska; Delaware; Hawaii; Louisiana; Montana; North Dakota; Oklahoma; West Virginia; Wyoming; and U.S. Territories. Daily work is completed from your home office, with occasional travel required for team meetings and company events.
Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role in the states of California, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, and Washington is: $75,348 - $98,894 per year. The base pay for this role in all other locations is: $67,813 - $89,005 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar 's unlimited vacation program and annual performance bonuses.

• Responsible for daily operations pertaining to Risk Adjustment including but not limited to: medical record reviews to report ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes for ACA and MA lines of business, potential CMS audits and medical record retrieval efforts.

• Maintain compliance with national standards and coding practices set by the ICD-10-CM coding guidelines for accuracy, as well as compliance with Risk adjustment production standards.

• Participate in CMS audits of Risk Adjustment activities, including but not limited to Risk Adjustment Data Validation audits.

• Develop relationships with key individuals to foster an increased understanding of the Risk Adjustment process.

• Other duties as assigned

• Experience coding in a variety of different Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.

Travel required - upto 5%
